description.value: Established in 1983, Seafair Gourmet Meats is an award-winning family-run butcher shop in Richmond that specialises in dry-aged beef — one of the few shops in the Lower Mainland to practise the technique. Beyond premium cuts, the shop carries locally sourced eggs, artisanal cheeses, house-made sausages, and other fine food products, all sourced from named BC and Fraser Valley farms. A touring cyclist stopping here will find high-quality, ready-to-cook provisions rather than a full supermarket.

address.value: 8671 Number 1 Road, Unit 12, Richmond, BC V7C 1V1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone 604-274-4740, address #12 - 8671 No. 1 Road, Richmond, BC V7C 1V1). No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; however, the site confirms the shop carries eggs, artisanal cheeses, cured meats, and other fine food products, supporting a 'basic groceries' finding.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible specialty butcher and fine food shop with a current website and confirmed contact details — a useful provisioning stop for touring cyclists.
